questions.definition: A **slump** in the economy often leads to fewer jobs available for workers.
options: a sudden rise in unemployment due to stock market crashes

questions.definition: She **took the initiative** and organised the team’s annual company picnic despite her busy schedule.
options: asked others to handle the planning
volunteered to organise the event without being asked
questions.answer: volunteered to organise the event without being asked

questions.definition: The **antagonist** in this thriller novel is a former detective who now works for the police force.
options: the main hero of the story
a villain who opposes the protagonist
a secondary character with no major role
questions.answer: a villain who opposes the protagonist

questions.definition: After years of hard work, they finally achieved **retrospect** on their long-term business plan.
options: a critical review of their past decisions
a complete failure due to poor planning
questions.answer: a critical review of their past decisions

questions.definition: The **suburb** near the city centre is known for its charming Victorian architecture and family-friendly amenities.
options: a densely populated urban area with skyscrapers
a residential area on the outskirts of a town or city
a historic district with ancient buildings
questions.answer: a residential area on the outskirts of a town or city
